description: This file defines the IStateControl interface and related enums and nested classes for controlling and monitoring state changes in a remote object within the Thunder PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: IStateControl
classes.description: An interface providing control over remote object states, including commands like suspend and resume, and notifications for state changes.

classes.name: IStateControl::INotification
classes.description: A nested interface for receiving notifications about state changes.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a state or command enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the state control with a given shell framework.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the remote object.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests a state change command (e.g., suspend or resume).

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for state changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.
